name: FSR 3 Upscaler (WIP)
author: Echo-Storm
description: Preview (work in progress), off until you switch it on. Upscales with AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3 in place of Lossless Scaling's NIS scaler, on any graphics card, with the motion measured from the frames: choose NIS as the Scaling Type and run the game in a window smaller than the screen (at the screen's own size it anti-aliases). AMD's FSR 3 runtime is included. Only one of the FSR 3 and DLSS 4 Upscalers works at a time.
